assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE portrait 2:3 flat minimalist geometric background for a branded THE FINALS community player card. Only the decorative backdrop, NOT a UI mockup. Strict MATTE, vector-poster look, sharp simple edges and completely SOLID UNIFORM colors. Absolutely NO lighting, glow, bloom, gradients, shadows, reflections, textures, shading, bevels, 3D, realistic objects, scenes, sci-fi, circuitry, text, numbers, words or logos. Consistent medium-fine 4–6px outlined strokes at a 1024px image width, combined with a few solid filled shapes. Main background is uniform near-black charcoal #0c1016. Reserve the central 55–60 percent as quiet charcoal for later card information. Decorative elements concentrated in asymmetrical edge groups but with enough visible graphic presence, not just two sparse lines. Keep to two or three recurring geometric elements, organized with intentional spacing and rhythm. Crop some shapes naturally at the edges; do not draw a complete enclosing frame. Every colored region must be a flat color with no luminance variation. OSPUZE energy-drink graphic identity. Accent solid golden yellow #f8bc2c only. Distinctive composition built from open C-shaped circular arcs, a few solid round disks and restrained clusters of small round dots suggesting effervescence. A large cropped partial yellow ring sits along the lower-right; a shorter contrasting arc plus about 10 neatly spaced dots occupy upper-left. Some medium-fine curved strokes and two short pill-shaped bars provide energy. Circular rhythm, bubbly but sophisticated; no diagonal chevrons, no hexagons.

Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the provided portrait 2:3 CNS geometric background. Edit target: the blue angular geometric composition on charcoal. Keep the overall layout, cropped open hexagon fragments, diagonal bars, chevrons, and large calm dark center, but make it rigorously FLAT AND MATTE. Remove ALL lighting effects: absolutely no glow, bloom, halo, bright cores, light spill, reflections, highlights, gradients, shadows, texture, shading, bevels, or 3D. Use ONLY uniform solid flat fills: background charcoal #0c1016 and accent blue #009dff. All visible blue geometry must be exactly the same single solid blue, with crisp edges, no lighter cyan or darker blue areas. Make the outlined strokes moderately thinner than in the reference, about 4–6 px at a 1024 px image width; reduce the widths of the solid diagonal bars by about 30 percent. Retain a deliberate mix of thin outlined geometric fragments and a few flat filled parallelograms at the outer edges, with most geometry in the upper-right and lower-left and a little at the sides. Strong but restrained premium minimalist vector-poster appearance. Central 55 percent remains empty charcoal, so card data can be added later. No text, logo, numbers, UI, enclosing border, objects, architecture or sci-fi elements. One complete full-bleed flat matte background only, not a mockup or contact sheet.
